blocks.text: جمل أطول ومفردات أقلّ شيوعًا. الكلمات الجديدة في معظمها مشروحة أدناه.
Ziri's mother came to get him.
My mother is not always at home.
blocks.note: أمي ليست موجودة في المنزل طيلة الوقت.

blocks.text: I don't care what your mother said.
Yanni's mother came looking for him.
Do you see the father and the mother?
If you don't stop, I'll tell your mother.
Your mother might tell you who your father is.
blocks.note: أنت لا تعرف حتى من هو أبوك.

blocks.text: Even your mother doesn't know who your father is.
blocks.note: حتى أمك لا تعلم من هو أبوك.

blocks.text: Ziri's father was Muslim, but his mother was Christian.
blocks.note: كان أب زيري مسلما، لكن أمه كانت مسيحية.
